context_diary: The check_compliance function with full_audit type returns three verification categories: email_unverified, phone_unverified, and terms_not_accepted. It can scope to specific account types and individual IDs. Running broad checks without scope filters hits data limits due to the 1498+ agent volume. Account_lookup with small limits helps sample before targeting specific compliance checks. The system tracks email verification, phone verification, and terms acceptance as core compliance pillars.
